F1_s1.explanation: Tentatively, the unit responds to small, roughly round dark spots or blotches set against a lighter surrounding surface, often repeated as dotted or mottled patterns. It also seems to respond to isolated high-contrast dark-on-light circular marks.

parsed.explanation: Tentatively, the unit responds to small, roughly round dark spots or blotches set against a lighter surrounding surface, often repeated as dotted or mottled patterns. It also seems to respond to isolated high-contrast dark-on-light circular marks.
parsed.evidence: Several boxed regions contain dark rounded marks on a paler ground (#2, #5, #6, #10, #11, #16, #18, #19), but others show little clear spotting (#1, #3, #12, #13), and the top activations are flat (10 to 7). Random images mostly score 0 to 1, though some reach 3 to 4 without obvious spotting (#7, #8).
parsed.missing_data: Synthetic tests varying dot size, density and contrast, plus tighter crops around the boxed regions, would show whether this is a real spot or blotch detector or something else.
